auth.login.heading: Sign in
auth.login.introVisitor: Sign in to place orders and manage repeat purchases.
auth.login.introStaff: You are signed in with a staff account. Sign in with your customer account to order.
auth.login.inviteOnly: Accounts are set up by our team. If you have been invited, use the activation link in your email.
auth.login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
auth.login.rateLimitedFor_one: Too many attempts. Try again in about {{count}} minute.
auth.login.rateLimitedFor_other: Too many attempts. Try again in about {{count}} minutes.
auth.login.notActivated: This account has not been activated yet. Use the link in your invitation email, or ask us to send a new one.
auth.login.emailNotVerified: Open the confirmation link we emailed you when you registered. Until you do, the account stays closed.
auth.login.pendingApproval: Your email is confirmed and the account is with our team for review. We will email you the moment it is open.
auth.login.locked: For your security this account is temporarily locked. Try again shortly.
auth.login.deactivated: This account is no longer active. Please contact us.
auth.login.deactivatedContact: This account is no longer active. Contact {{email}} to restore it.
validation.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.acceptTerms: You need to accept the terms to create an account.
auth.register.formIntro: A few details and you are set up. {{business}} quotes prices per market, so the country you choose decides the currency you are shown.
auth.register.countryHint: This sets the currency every price is quoted in.
auth.register.mobileHint: We use this to reach you about an order, not for marketing.
auth.register.mobileHintPrefix: Include the country code, e.g. {{prefix}}. We use this to reach you about an order, not for marketing.
auth.register.organizationHint: Leave it blank if you are ordering as an individual.
auth.register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Only you will ever know it.
auth.register.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of business
auth.register.approvalNotice: New accounts are reviewed by our team before the first order. You will get an email as soon as yours is open - usually within one working day.
auth.register.failed: We could not create your account. Please try again in a moment.
auth.register.sentBody: If {{email}} can have an account here, a confirmation link is on its way. Open it to finish setting up.
auth.register.sentSpam: It should arrive within a few minutes. Check your spam folder too.
auth.register.sentApproval: Once you have confirmed the address, our team reviews the account before your first order. We will email you when it is open.
auth.register.resent: Sent. Give it a few minutes, then check your spam folder.
auth.register.resendFailed: We could not send it. Please try again in a moment.
auth.register.bodyByInvitation: {{business}} sells to business accounts, so each one is set up by our team. Once we invite you, the email contains a link that activates your account and lets you choose your own password.
auth.register.invitedBody: Open the activation link in your invitation email. It only works once, and it expires, so use the most recent one.
auth.register.needAccountNoEmail: Get in touch with your account manager and we will set one up.
auth.register.needAccountWithEmail: Email {{email}} and we will set one up.
auth.verify.noToken: No confirmation token was found in this link.
auth.verify.failed: We could not confirm your email address.
auth.verify.readyBody: Sign in with the password you chose and you can start ordering.
auth.verify.pendingApprovalHeading: Thank you - your email is confirmed
auth.verify.pendingApprovalBody: Our team reviews each new account before the first order. We will email you as soon as yours is open. There is nothing else for you to do.
auth.verify.expiredBody: Confirmation links last 48 hours. Ask for a new one below and it will arrive within a few minutes.
auth.verify.usedTitle: This link has already been used
auth.verify.usedBody: Your email address is confirmed. Try signing in - and if the account is still being reviewed, we will email you when it is open.
auth.verify.invalidTitle: This confirmation link is not valid
auth.verify.invalidBody: The link may have been copied incompletely. Try opening it straight from the email rather than pasting it.
auth.verify.deactivatedTitle: This account is no longer active
auth.verify.deactivatedBody: Please contact us and we will sort it out.
auth.verify.failedTitle: We could not confirm your email address
auth.verify.failedBody: Something went wrong at our end. Please try again in a moment.
auth.verify.resent: If that address is waiting on a confirmation link, a new one has been sent.
auth.verify.resendFailed: We could not send it. Please try again in a moment.
auth.forgot.heading: Reset your password
auth.forgot.intro: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
auth.forgot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.forgot.sentBody: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for a limited time, so use it soon.
auth.forgot.sentSpam: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder before asking for another.
auth.reset.heading: Choose a new password
auth.reset.intro: You will sign in with this straight afterwards.
auth.reset.failed: The password could not be reset.
auth.reset.tokenExpired: This reset link has expired. Reset links are short-lived for security - request a new one.
auth.reset.tokenUsed: This reset link has already been used. If it was not you, request a new one and sign in straight away.
auth.reset.tokenInvalid: This reset link is not valid. Try opening it directly from the email rather than pasting it.
auth.reset.tokenUnknown: We could not reset your password. Please request a new link.
auth.activate.heading: Activate your account
auth.activate.choosePasswordHint: At least 12 characters. A short phrase you will remember beats a short jumble you will not.
auth.activate.noToken: No activation token was found in the link.
auth.activate.readySignedIn: You are signed in and can start ordering right away.
auth.activate.readySignIn: Sign in with the password you just chose to start ordering.
auth.activate.expiredBody: Invitation links are time-limited for security. Ask us to send a new one and it will arrive within a few minutes.
auth.activate.usedTitle: This invitation has already been used
auth.activate.usedBody: Your account is set up. Sign in with the password you chose - or reset it if you cannot remember.
auth.activate.invalidTitle: This activation link is not valid
auth.activate.invalidBody: The link may have been copied incompletely. Try opening it straight from the email rather than pasting it.
auth.activate.deactivatedTitle: This account is no longer active
auth.activate.deactivatedBody: Please contact us and we will sort it out.
auth.activate.unknownTitle: We could not activate your account
auth.activate.unknownBody: Something went wrong at our end. Please try again in a moment.

footer.tagline: Industrial and business supplies, sourced and delivered.
cart.emptyBody: Everything you add stays here until you check out.
cart.needsApprovalBody: It will go to your approver before it is confirmed. You can still place it now.
cart.fixFlagged: Fix the items flagged above to continue.
cart.changeNotSaved: That change could not be saved.
cart.itemNotRemoved: That item could not be removed.
cart.notEmptied: The cart could not be emptied.
checkout.howWouldYouLikeTo: How would you like to pay?
checkout.optionalDeliveryInstructionsAPo: Optional. Delivery instructions, a PO number, a site contact.
checkout.thereIsNothingToCheck: There is nothing to check out.
checkout.confirmWhereThisIsGoing: Confirm where this is going and how you would like to pay. Nothing is charged until the next step.
checkout.youHaveNoSavedAddresses: You have no saved addresses yet. Add one to continue.
checkout.youWillBeTakenTo: You will be taken to our payment provider to complete the payment securely. Card details never touch this site.
checkout.placeTheOrderNowAnd: Place the order now and have a secure payment link emailed for approval. The order waits at Pending payment until it is paid.
checkout.fixTheseBeforePlacingThe: Fix these before placing the order
checkout.placingThisOrderDoesNot: Placing this order does not charge you yet. Payment is taken on the next step, on our payment provider’s own secure page, and is only confirmed once they verify it.
checkout.chooseADeliveryAddressTo: Choose a delivery address to continue.
checkout.upiOpensOnTheUpiTab: Checkout opens on the UPI tab. You can still switch to another method there.
orderConfirmation.thisOrderHadAlreadyBee: This order had already been placed — we have not created a second one.
orderConfirmation.theLinkIsTimeLimited: The link is time-limited, so it is worth paying it soon. If it expires before anyone acts on it, contact us and we will send a new one.
orderConfirmation.forSecurityTheLinkAppe: For security the link appears only in that email. We cannot show it here, and neither can anyone signed in to this account.
payment.thisIsTakingLongerThan: This is taking longer than usual
payment.thisOrderWasAlreadyPlaced: This order was already placed — we have not created a second one.
payment.yourBankHasAcceptedIt: Your bank has accepted it. We are waiting for our payment provider to confirm, which usually takes a few seconds. Please do not close this page or pay again.
payment.yourPaymentHasNotBeen: Your payment has not been lost. It will be confirmed automatically, and you will get an email when it is. You can safely leave this page and check your order.
payment.retryingUsesThisSameOrder: Retrying uses this same order — it will never create a second one.
payment.thisOrderIsWithYour: This order is with your approver. Payment opens once it is approved.
product.signInToAddThis: Sign in to add this to your cart.
safety.heading: Safety and product information
safety.euResponsibleHint: Contact for EU product safety matters.
device.heading: Medical device information
chat.aiNotice: You are chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.
chat.aiVendorNotice: Replies are generated by AI ({{vendor}}). Your messages are sent to them to answer, and are stored so our team can follow up.
chat.aiCanBeWrong: It can be wrong. Check anything important with us before you order.
chat.privacyNotice: We use these details to answer you and to follow up. See our privacy notice for how long we keep them and what rights you have.
catalog.inStockHint: Hide anything that has sold out.
catalog.onOfferHint: Products with money off the usual price.
catalog.productsThatCanBePut: Products you can set to arrive again and again.
scheduleBuilder.aMonthShorterThanThe: A month shorter than the date you pick runs on its last day.
scheduleBuilder.yourOwnAddressIsFilled: Your own address is filled in. Change it if a finance colleague approves payments.
scheduleBuilder.thisOptionIsSwitchedOff: This option is switched off at the moment. You can still order normally.
scheduleBuilder.weWillPlaceTheOrder: We will place the order for you on the schedule you choose. You can pause or cancel it at any time.
scheduleBuilder.sendAPaymentLinkEach: Send a payment link each time
scheduleBuilder.eachDeliveryCreatesAnOrd: Each delivery creates an order and emails a secure payment link for approval. Nothing is charged automatically.
scheduleBuilder.eachDeliveryIsChargedTo: Each delivery is charged to a payment mandate. You will be asked to authorise the mandate with our payment provider before this starts.
scheduleBuilder.aMandateIsNeededBefore: A mandate is needed before this can run
scheduleBuilder.weWillSetTheSchedule: We will set the schedule up now and ask you to authorise the mandate with our payment provider. Until that is done, deliveries will not be charged automatically.
scheduleBuilder.anEstimateOnlyEveryDeliv: An estimate only. Every delivery is priced fresh against the catalogue, tax, stock and your account limits on the day it runs — so the amount can change.
scheduleBuilder.enterWhoShouldReceiveThe: Enter who should receive the payment link.
scheduleBuilder.tickTheBoxAboveTo: Tick the box above to continue.
scheduleBuilder.youCanPauseOrCancel: You can pause or cancel this at any time from your account.
orderDetail.tellUsWhySoWe: Tell us why, so we can put it right.
orderDetail.whetherAnOrderCanStill: Whether an order can still be cancelled depends on how far along it is. We will tell you either way.
orderDetail.ifYouHaveAlreadyPaid: If you have already paid, the refund is arranged separately and we will email you about it.
profile.yourContactDetailsAndHow: Your contact details and how we reach you about orders.
profile.setByUsOnYour: Set by us on your account. Checkout applies them, so it is worth knowing them before you build a large order.
profile.toChangeYourEmailAddress: To change your email address or organisation, get in touch — they identify your account.
yourData.heading: Your data
yourData.intro: You can ask for a copy of everything we hold about you, or ask us to erase it.
yourData.requestCopy: Request a copy of my data
yourData.exportStarted: We are preparing your copy. You will be emailed when it is ready to download.
yourData.erasureReceived: Your erasure request has been received. We will respond within one month.
yourData.requestFailed: That request could not be sent. Please try again.
yourData.readyExpires: The download link stops working on {{when}}.
yourData.rightsFootnote: These are your rights under the GDPR (Articles 15, 17 and 20). We answer within one month. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to your national data protection authority.
yourData.confirmDescription: Please read this before you continue.
yourData.confirmPointAccount: Your account, contact details, addresses, saved baskets and any chat enquiries will be deleted. You will no longer be able to sign in.
yourData.confirmPointOrders: Orders you have already placed are kept. Tax law requires us to keep invoices for several years, but they will no longer be linked to you by name.
yourData.confirmPointReview: A member of staff reviews the request. If an order is unpaid or a return is still open, we will complete that first and tell you.
yourData.confirmPointExportFirst: This cannot be undone. If you want a copy of your data, request that first.
scheduleDetail.noMandateAuthorisedYetDel: No mandate authorised yet — deliveries cannot be charged.
scheduleDetail.everyDeliveryIsPricedFres: Every delivery is priced fresh against the catalogue, tax, stock and your account limits on the day it runs, so the amount can change between deliveries.
scheduleDetail.pausingOrCancellingOnlyAf: Pausing or cancelling only affects future deliveries. Orders already placed keep their own status and are not changed.
addressForm.label: Label
addressForm.optionalHeadOfficeSite2: Optional — “Head office”, “Site 2”. Helps you pick the right one later.
addressForm.useAsMyDefaultDelivery: Use as my default delivery address
addressForm.useAsMyDefaultBilling: Use as my default billing address
activatePage.atLeast12CharactersA: At least 12 characters. A short phrase you will remember beats a short jumble you will not.
activatePage.noActivationTokenWasFound: No activation token was found in the link.
chat.eGDoYouHave: e.g. do you have 22G safety cannula?
chat.tellUsWhoYouAre: Tell us who you are and we will answer your questions about the catalogue. Our team can then follow up if you need a quotation.
chat.answersComeFromThisCatalogue: Answers come from this catalogue. Not clinical advice.
chat.thisAnswerWasCutOff: This answer was cut off. Please ask again for the full reply.
home.everythingYourBusinessOrdersIn: Everything your business orders, in one place
home.productsAppearHereAsSoon: Products appear here as soon as they are published. Check back shortly.
home.theFullCatalogueCanBe: The full catalogue can be filtered by category and price, and sorted by name or price.
addresses.usedAtCheckoutForDelivery: Used at checkout for delivery and billing.
addresses.addOneHereOrAt: Add one here, or at checkout when you place your first order.
addresses.removingAnAddressDoesNot: Removing an address does not change any order already placed — each order keeps its own copy of where it was sent.
schedules.standingOrdersWePlaceFor: Standing orders we place for you on a schedule. Pause, resume or cancel any of them at any time — only future deliveries are affected.
orders.onceYouPlaceAnOrder: Once you place an order it will appear here, with its progress and delivery details.
countryPicker.defaultsToYourCountryS: Defaults to your country's currency. Change it if you would rather be quoted in another.
countryPicker.pricesAreShownInYour: Prices are shown in your country's currency. You can change this at any time from the header.
countryPicker.locationAccessWasDeclinedT: Location access was declined. That is fine — the country you choose above is what we use.
serviceBanner.weAreWorkingOnIt: We are working on it — your cart and orders are safe. Please try again in a few minutes.
serviceBanner.weAreHavingTroubleReaching: We are having trouble reaching the store.
notFound.weCouldNotFindThat: We could not find that page
notFound.theLinkMayBeOut: The link may be out of date, or the product may no longer be available.
storeLayout.youAreOfflineYouCan: You are offline. You can keep browsing what has already loaded — changes will not be saved until you reconnect.
placeholder.thisPageIsNotBuilt: This page is not built yet
errorBoundary.heading: This page stopped working
errorBoundary.body: Nothing in your cart has been lost. Reloading usually clears it.
